title: Moss Causeway
message:
Moss Causeway: an original loop in the manner of Tim Wright (Shadow of the Beast II/III).
D Dorian, speed 5, four stages that add parts. Set volumes only, a shimmer on the melody,
two bends, an echo four rows behind at the end. Sound library presets only.
Source: songs/amiga_moss_causeway.gen.js. Rendered and measured, not listened to.
